new_series.title: Colin from Accounts
new_series.synopsis: It's been three years since Gordon's ill-fated proposal, and the pair haven't spoken much. But a chance encounter at a suburban GP clinic throws their plans for forward momentum off course.

new_series.title: The News Quiz
new_series.synopsis: Andy Zaltzman is back for a brand new series of The News Quiz, with panellists Pierre Novellie, Alasdair Beckett-King, Coco Khan and Kyrah Gray.

new_series.title: Your Mum
new_series.synopsis: Laura Smyth is joined by comedians Sara Barron and Nish Kumar to hear about the indelible mark their mothers left on them.

new_series.title: Unspeakable
new_series.synopsis: Phil Wang and Susie Dent challenge guests to invent new words and help create the new ultimate Unspeakable dictionary. With guests Jessie Cave, Armando Iannucci and Chloe Petts.

new_series.title: Drama on 4
new_series.synopsis: A young conscript joins Alpha Company in Vietnam in 1969. Their aim? To survive. If they can. These are the stories of those who did.

new_series.title: The Villa Forgotten by Jeanette Winterson
new_series.synopsis: Toni visits the house she’s just inherited. But the past cannot be erased. An original, eerie story, written and read by Jeanette Winterson.

new_series.title: I'm Not A Monster Presents...
new_series.synopsis: Josh Baker investigates one of the biggest missing-person cases of our time. American journalist Austin Tice vanished in Syria, but the US president says he’s alive.

new_series.title: Stand-Up Specials
new_series.synopsis: Omid explores identity, stereotypes and first impressions, from growing up as the son of Iranian immigrants to the assumptions we all make about one another.

new_series.title: The Box
new_series.synopsis: Joey Essex, John Bercow, Jenny Ryan, JB Gill, Danny Aarons, Ranvir Singh, Sara Davies, Graeme Souness, Ellie Taylor and Shakira Khan compete in high-pressure challenges as they try to avoid a head-to-head showdown in the Duel and becoming the first famous face to be sent packing.
